preconditions.description: The number of computers is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of cables is between 1 and 200,000.
The computers are indexed from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The total number of cables in the final scheme is at least the number of the already present cables.

postconditions.expression: all(ci == cj or di == dj for i < j in range(p))
postconditions.description: Each computer has its cables grouped into pairs, and no two cables within a pair go in opposite directions.
The total number of cables in the final scheme is at most 500,000.
